step1_figure.description: The circuit consists of a first-stage CMOS inverter driving a second-stage 2-input NAND gate. One input of the NAND gate is tied to VDD, configuring it to act as an inverter. The output is loaded with a 50 fF capacitor.

tPLH.description: Low-to-high propagation delay of the overall circuit (from input rising to output rising).

equation.explanation: The total low-to-high delay is the sum of the high-to-low delay of the first inverter (NMOS pulling down) and the low-to-high delay of the NAND gate (PMOS pulling up).
equation.assumptions: Digital RC delay model, step input.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Delay is dominated by the 50fF load capacitance being charged by the NAND gate's PMOS.

tPHL.description: High-to-low propagation delay of the overall circuit (from input falling to output falling).

equation.explanation: The total high-to-low delay is the sum of the low-to-high delay of the first inverter (PMOS pulling up) and the high-to-low delay of the NAND gate (two series NMOS pulling down).
equation.assumptions: Digital RC delay model, step input.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming Wn=1um, Wp=2um, L=0.15um. Rn = 403 ohm, Rp = 1086 ohm. C_int ~ 4fF, C_load = 50fF. tPHL = 0.7 * 1086 * 4f + 0.7 * (403 + 403) * 50f = 3ps + 28.2ps = 31.2ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Delay is dominated by the 50fF load capacitance being discharged by the two series NMOS devices in the NAND gate.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the low-to-high and high-to-low propagation delays of the circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Fig 13.31
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=1 W_xm3=1 W_xm5=1
.param L_xm1=0.15 L_xm3=0.15 L_xm5=0.15
.param W_xm2=2 W_xm4=2 W_xm6=2
.param L_xm2=0.15 L_xm4=0.15 L_xm6=0.15

Vin Vin 0 pulse(0 1.8 0.5n 50p 50p 1n 2.5n)

* DUT
xm1 N001 Vin 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
VDD VDD 0 1.8
xm2 N001 Vin VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm3 Vout N001 N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm4 Vout N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
Cload Vout 0 5e-14
xm5 N002 VDD 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6 Vout VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}

.control
tran 10p 3n
meas tran tPLH trig v(Vin) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(Vout) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran tPHL trig v(Vin) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(Vout) val=0.9 fall=1
print tPLH tPHL
quit
.endc
